title: Quick check: Local and Remote Images

questions.prompt: In the context of “Local and Remote Images” and “Local image imports”, What should be supplied for an image with meaningful content?
options: An empty alt value for every image, including informative diagrams.
A database password in the image URL.
A fixed oversized asset regardless of viewport.
Useful alternative text, correct dimensions or sizing behavior, and an appropriate loading strategy.
questions.answer_key: Useful alternative text, correct dimensions or sizing behavior, and an appropriate loading strategy.
questions.explanation: Alternative text depends on purpose; dimensions and loading strategy help accessibility and performance.

questions.prompt: While implementing “Local and Remote Images”, How should a remote image host be enabled for the Next.js Image component?
options: Allow all remote hosts by default without considering risk.
Allow-list the required remote source patterns as narrowly as practical.
Move image credentials into client-visible source code.
Disable dimension handling on every image.
questions.answer_key: Allow-list the required remote source patterns as narrowly as practical.
questions.explanation: A narrow remotePatterns configuration controls which remote image sources the optimization layer will accept.

questions.prompt: When reviewing “Local and Remote Images”, Why does font and image optimization matter beyond download size?
options: It automatically fixes every accessibility issue.
It removes the need to check contrast or readable typography.
It guarantees identical rendering on every browser.
It can improve layout stability and perceived performance when loading and dimensions are handled deliberately.
questions.answer_key: It can improve layout stability and perceived performance when loading and dimensions are handled deliberately.
questions.explanation: Resource optimization supports performance, but visual layout and accessibility still need verification.

review_note: Draft question set with module-specific concepts. Review item wording and answer accuracy before publication; learner-facing APIs should expose prompt/options only and release correctness feedback after grading.
